review_method: Codex spawn_task autonomous PR. Documented root cause chain: container-publish workflows trigger on push to ao_kernel/** or pyproject.toml → publish image (success) → deploy workflows fire via workflow_run: completed → deploy job first step 'Validate trusted deploy configuration' hard-fails because GCP auth repository variables (GCP_PROJECT_ID, GCP_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY_PROVIDER, GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT, RELEASE_GATE_SERVICE_NAME, AO_RELEASE_GATE_*) are deliberately unset (Cloud Run intentionally pre-cutover). Pre-cutover false-red painted every main push.
verdict_rationale: Gating deploy lane behind operator-controlled repository variable (e.g. ENABLE_CLOUD_RUN_AUTO_DEPLOY) prevents pre-cutover noise without weakening deploy gate semantics post-cutover. 2 workflow YAML conditional + 2 regression tests pin the gate behavior. Pre-cutover state explicitly documented in .claude/plans/CLOUD-RUN-AUTO-DEPLOY-LANE-FLAG.md.
key_findings_summary: False-red on every main push since deploy auth never configured
Operator flag-based gate preserves post-cutover behavior
